judge: {"branch": ["dig"], "notes": "None of the three items names the thing that has to change. Item 1 says what to add (a PDF export control) and where from a user's point of view (the billing page), but not the page/component/route or the control that must change. Item 2 says what to limit (invoices going back three years) but not the query, service, or endpoint where that limit is applied. Item 3 says what to produce (invoice PDFs from billing data) but not the module, class, or endpoint that generates them. Each item needs to be made specific before it can be estimated."}
